title: Pre-Push Orphan GC Quarantine (full mark-and-sweep) ref
desc: T3 ref for the pre-push orphan GC-quarantine guard: design rationale (recoverability enables approximate mark), 3-hop bound, root-script focus + code-smell note, runtime-critical backstop, origin.
steps: DESIGN RATIONALE (user 2026-06-19): the MOVE-not-delete recoverability is WHY the mark can be approximate -- a false quarantine is restorable from .tmp/unused-DATE/, so full fixpoint and exhaustive edge extraction are over-engineering. Simplicity wins.
3-HOP BOUND rationale: most real reference chains are shallow; 3 hops from roots covers common cases; deeper chains falsely swept are recoverable. Do not chase generic path strings to infinity.

ROOT-SCRIPT FOCUS: primarily follow edges that involve root scripts. NOTE: a root script referencing ANOTHER root script is a mild code-smell (not beautiful) -- tolerated, but a sign to flatten and clarify the root set, not to deepen the walk.
RUNTIME-CRITICAL BACKSTOP: never quarantine known-config (.gitignore, csproj, sln, LICENSE, lock files); entry-config roots + transitive mark should already cover these -- belt-and-suspenders.

ORIGIN: born 2026-06-19 from session cruft (leftover sandbox proto files, duplicate stashes) -- the AI does not clean its own garbage, so the guard enforces it at push, transparently, without blocking.
